Tests batch bytes extraction API (extract_batch)

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final inputs = await Future.wait((jsonDecode(r'[{"bytes":"pdf/fake_memo.pdf","filename":"fake_memo.pdf","kind":"bytes"}]') as List<dynamic>).map((element) => createExtractInputFromJson(json: jsonEncode(element))));
    final result = await XbergBridge.extractBatch(inputs);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].mimeType);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
